crossRefs.note: Now there was long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew…

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.
translations.bsb: The battle that day was intense, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by the servants of David.
translations.kjv: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
translations.asv: And the battle was very sore that day: and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
